description: A person is allowed even when every class, purpose, path and sign-up rule blocks or challenges.
policy:
version: 1
mode: enforce
defaults:
  verified: block
  declared_unverifiable: block
  claimed_failed: block
  unknown_automation: block
purposes:
  training: block
  search: block
  user_fetch: block
  agent: block
  preview: block
  ads: block
  other: block
paths:
  "/*":
    verified: block
    claimed_failed: block
    unknown_automation: block
signup:
  "/*":
    verified: challenge
    declared_unverifiable: challenge
    claimed_failed: challenge
    unknown_automation: challenge

response.body: This site's policy does not allow this agent (unknown, unknown). Operators can get verified at https://posterna.com/operators
